verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms an actual llms.txt file exists at api-dashboard.search.brave.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the API for LLM consumption, and Brave also publishes an LLM Context endpoint and agent-oriented guides (Claude/MCP, Dify, OpenClaw, n8n) plus an official MCP server, making the API broadly agent-discoverable. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/docs.md fallback (both 404) and no independent confirmation that agents actually consume llms.txt successfully in practice.
